name: GPU Loan Loop
hook: Lend them cash so they can buy your chips to fund your cash
tagline: A frantic corporate executive shuffles IOUs around a revolving conveyor belt that pumps GPUs directly into a hollow cardboard data center. Cash out to wire the vendor check into a discrete offshore vault before the credit audits hit. If you hold too long, the circular balance sheet collapses under its own fictitious guarantees.
